page.layout: Running head across the top (Hebrew letters, left and right), page number at top left. Two columns of dictionary entries, separated by a vertical rule. Left column opens with a centred Hebrew letter heading. No margin notes, no footnotes.

main_text.p: נָא quaeso, nunc, crudum, Exod. 12. 9. Part. Rad. vel, ab אַנָּא quaeso, vel, No. f. m. Rad. נָא, vel, אַיִן [?] quo?.
נאבֶרָה peribimus, fut. Kal, 1. plur. parag. Rad. אבר.
נאורות utres, No. pl. fæm. à f. m. No. Rad. נאר uter.
נארך parag. נאַרְדִי magnificus, Part. Niph. f. m. Rad. ארך.
הַנֶּאֱהָבִים dilecti, Part. Niph. pl. m. Rad. אהב.
נאוה decora est, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. (cum ו, pro ה) Rad. נאוה pulchrum esse, vel, est præt. Niph. 3. f. m. R. אוה.
נאוה conveniens, נאוה decet, Part. Ben. Kal, f. m. & fæm. Rad. (cum ו, pro 3. Rad. ה) נאוה vel, Part. Niph. f. m. & f. R. אוה.
נאוו decoræ sunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. (cum ו, pro ה,) Rad. נאוה; vel præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. אוה.
נאור lucidus factus est, præt. Niph. 3. sing. m, vel, Part. Niph. f. m. R. אור.
נאות caulæ, pro נוות, No. pl. fæm. à f. m. נוה, & sing. fæm. נוה; Rad. נוה inhabitavit.
נאות acquiescemus, Gen. 34. 35. pro נאת parag. נאותה, fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. יאת.
נאור accinctus est, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & נאור vel, נאור accinctus, Part. Niph. sing. m. Rad. אור.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some letters are faint or broken in the scan; Hebrew forms are transcribed as best read and may contain small errors, especially the pointing in נָא, נאבֶרָה, נאַרְדִי, הַנֶּאֱהָבִים, and the last entry. The Hebrew in the running head is unclear and marked [?]. The word "אַיִן" is marked [?]. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout (e.g. "quaeso" for printed "quaefo"). The last line "Niph." may be incomplete at the foot of the column.
